# Kit base — reusable answers for application forms (fixture)

## How to use this pack

Square brackets `[...]` are placeholders — fill them in or delete them; never send one as-is.

---

## 1. Availability

**Short (one line, for form fields):**
> Available from 12 January 2027: full-time until late February, then 16–20 hours per week through June 2027.

**Long (cover letters, emails, "anything else?" boxes):**
> I'm available from 12 January 2027 — full-time until late February, then 16–20 hours per week during semester.

---

## 2. Work rights

**"Do you have the right to work in Australia?"**
> Yes. I hold a temporary visa with work rights, valid to the end of 2027. I can provide a confirmation on request.

If the form only allows a dropdown, choose the option closest to "Yes — visa with work restrictions". **Never** tick [unrestricted work rights].

**"Do you require sponsorship?"**
> No — not for this engagement.

> [!todo] Before the first application
> - [ ] Check current conditions on [the government portal] — verify before stating.
> - [ ] Download the result as a PDF letter.

---

## 3. Salary / rate expectations

No market data has been researched — do not quote a number you have not checked.

**Neutral answer (default):**
> I'm open to the advertised range.

**If the form forces a number:**
> [your hourly rate — TODO, check the ad or award minimums]

> [!todo]
> - [ ] Look up the award minimum and write your floor here.

## 6. Common screening questions

**Years of experience**
> About one year of commercial experience.

For a numeric field, enter **1**. Do not round up to 2.

**Notice period**
> I can start on 12 January 2027.

> [!todo]
> - [ ] Confirm with the current employer whether any notice is needed.

**Location / commute**
> I live in Sydney [suburb — TODO] and can commute to the office or work hybrid.

**Availability for interviews (December travel)**
> I'm travelling for part of December, but I'm available for video interviews — I'll be in [timezone — TODO, e.g. UTC−6 / Mexico City], so mornings Sydney time work best.

**Why part-time?**
> I'm studying a master's degree through June 2027, so part-time lets me commit hours I can keep.

## 7. Follow-up email (7 days after applying)

**Subject:** Following up — [Role] application, Alex Example

> Hi [Name / Company team],
>
> I applied for the [Role] position on [date] and wanted to follow up briefly. I'm still very interested in contributing to [one specific thing about the company or role].
>
> As a quick reminder: I'm a software engineer with about a year of commercial experience, available from 12 January 2027.
>
> If it helps, I'm happy to do a short call at a time that suits you. My CV is attached again for convenience.
>
> Kind regards,
> Alex Example · alex.example@example.com · +61 400 000 000 · linkedin.com/in/alex-example

(≈60 words. Send one follow-up only; if there is no reply after a second week, mark it closed.)
